clips.title: The story
paras: In Coldridge Valley, Durnan Furcutter waits for his scalding mornbrew inside Anvilmar. The cup must reach him before the mountain air cools it.

A fresh cup of mornbrew is bound for Durnan Furcutter inside Anvilmar. A courier delayed on the way to Grelin Whitebeard leaves the brew at risk of cooling in Coldridge Valley's frost. Durnan wants it scalding, so there are only a few minutes to carry the mug up the snowy path into the mountain hall before it goes cold.
